STUDENT ARTICLE:
Waking up at early hours in the morning can be classified as a daunting task, more so if we must go to class. Falling back to sleep whilst watching your online classes can cost you time and your academic success. Having this in mind, in this article I’ll be going over the main reasons as to why university students should physically attend to their classes. Have you ever felt lost during a class? Because I have, a ton of times. Thankfully, due to my physical attendance in class, I am able to inquire the teacher regarding any possible questions that may arise during the class, and teacher will swiftly veer me on to the correct path, and I am eternally grateful for this. since it is not as easy, fast, and comprehensible, when you are learning from a distance - watching classes online Another upside to attending classes in-person is your immediate access to resources (eg teachers books) and facilities (e.g. labs, libraries...) , I definitely do not have this at home! In conclusion, the decision to attend classes in-person is ultimately left to the student, but I firmly believe that teachers can entourage their fellow students to physically attend their classes, a way to encourage such behaviour could be by implementing. "extra-points" reward system to those attending closes in-person, helping the early birds achieve higher grades!
